topics.purpose: Define an operation request as inert candidate intent containing exact operation, target, arguments, requester/context and optional execution constraints.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant request has a distinct request identity.
semantics.operation_rule: Request references one exact operation identity.
semantics.target_rule: Request target is exact and never inferred from cwd, UI selection or display context.
semantics.argument_rule: Arguments are explicit candidate data until validation succeeds.
semantics.context_rule: Requester/auth/session/context refs are explicit where applicable.
semantics.constraint_rule: Deadline, idempotency key, dry-run, resource budget and other execution constraints are explicit.
semantics.inert_rule: A request has no side effect merely by existing.
semantics.authority_rule: Request origin does not determine authorization outcome.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

hard_gates.condition: model text treated as request without parsing
